---
title: An example is a little argument
description: A few lines of code can do the work of a long explanation.
date: 2026-10-12
categories: [Code, Writing]
---

A useful example is small enough to hold in mind and complete enough to run.
It gives the reader something concrete to question, change, and understand.

## Start small

```python
def twice(value):
    return value + value

assert twice(21) == 42
```

The explanation can grow from here, one decision at a time.
